animations.name: global-ease
animations.css: transition: border-color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1), color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1), opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1), background-color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1)
animations.description: Primary easing curve for button and link interactions throughout the site

animations.name: link-icon-transform
animations.description: Transition for link icons and underlines on hover

animations.name: modal-fade
animations.description: Linear fade transition for modal open/close states

animations.name: lightbox-scale
animations.css: transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1), opacity 0.3s linear, visibility 0.3s linear
animations.description: Scale and fade animation for lightbox video player appearance

animations.name: video-interface-slide
animations.description: Slide-up animation for video player interface controls

animations.name: play-icon-scale
animations.description: Scale animation for play button icon on video hover

animations.name: carousel-blur
animations.description: JS-driven blur and scale animation for carousel slides transitioning between prev/center/next states

animations.name: scroll-text-opacity
animations.description: JS-driven scroll-triggered opacity animation for text reveal sections

animations.name: spin
animations.css: @keyframes spin { 0% { transform: rotate(0) } to { transform: rotate(360deg) } }
animations.description: Continuous rotation animation for loading spinners

insights: The design system uses a signature pill-shaped (rounded-full) button style with a distinctive cubic-bezier easing curve (0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1) for all interactive transitions, creating a smooth, premium feel
Video content is central to the experience with custom player controls featuring glassmorphism styling (backdrop-filter: blur) and coordinated show/hide transitions for interface elements
The carousel implements a unique JS-driven blur/scale effect where non-active slides are visually de-emphasized with 22px blur and 0.8 scale, creating depth without traditional pagination dots
